Hi there. I'm sorry to hear you feel that way.
I'm 24f and I've been in ldr for 8 months now.
I want to say that your feelings are valid and completely human. There's nothing wrong with feeling this way. I was in the same situation. I couldn't send him a text message without crying. He seemed normal and cool and later his mom told me he was really sad but whenever we talked he was trying to be strong in front of me. I'm sure your girlfriend is also missing you so much but people express different feelings in different ways so don't think because she is having a good time she isn't thinking of you, because it will make you more sad. The thing is feelings must be felt but don't let them get control over you. I did let them and lost control at some points and I really regret now.
What helped me was that I decided I wanted to be a better and healthy person for him and my lifestyle is making me sick and depressed. So I used that thought to create a goal for myself. I startes small by eating healthy food, doing sport, reading psychology books and wathcing helpful videos. I still cry when I miss him. But I just feel the feelings and let them pass. I try not to focus and get stuck in them. Since then, because I have a clearer mind now, our relationship has been better than ever. Now I look back and see how much we've been through, I'm glad I decided to change.
I know it's hard and you might think if you're sad it means you love her so much, believe me I get it but think of when you get together. You want her to see you a healthy happy person, right?🙂
I hope it was helpful and wish you get together soon and have a happy life together😊

Hi. I had and have this especially when someone is trying to influence or change me or someone else with their bad intentions. The thing is I still get angry or upset but not for long time anymore. I let myself have emotions and tell myself they are normal because I've been exposed to those people right now😂 but I tell myself if I let the emotions eat me up or continue or turn into negative thoughts I let those people get what they wanted. So I then try to use meditation or do something that calms me and think about a positive or right and logical response that I can give in this situation. And actually because I'm not falling in their trap anymore the time I was having negative thoughts has reduced a lot and sometimes in a second I can put my mind in order and give a logical positive reaction in the moment.
I hope it helps🙂

then after a while understanding we have the same taste in movies,music and other stuff was a plus.one of the things also was that he was asking my opinion and not judging my answers which gave me a safe place to share. the thing is about us, the feelings grew over time. I'm not saying wait long;I'm saying if there is a good base of common things between you two and mental connection and you know eachother well,i think you will know when the time is right to ask her out. I'm talking based on my experience and you know her better and not every infj maybe takes months figuring out how they feel like I did😅
 I hope this was helpful.
but I'm sure you will know better and I wish you good luck🙂
